title: DeGCSConfig
description: Schema contract for the DeGCSConfig frozen dataclass governing German compound splitting (GCS) runtime parameters.

enabled.description: Whether German compound splitting is active during token processing.

pos_tags.description: Whitespace-separated POS tag identifiers restricting compound splitting eligibility. Null disables tag-based filtering.

split_mode.description: Split mode identifier controlling compound decomposition strategy (e.g. 'greedy', 'balanced'). Null uses library default.

part_singularization.description: Singularization strategy applied to compound parts (e.g. 'all', 'none'). Null uses library default.

preserve_compound_word.description: Whether the original unsplit compound word is preserved alongside its decomposed parts.

add_parts_to_wordlist.description: Whether individual compound parts are added to the output vocabulary wordlist.

skip_merge_fractions.description: Whether fractional compound merge candidates are excluded from splitting.

mask_unknown_parts.description: Whether compound parts not resolvable in the dictionary are masked or suppressed.
